notes.title: Terminator: Resistance Annihilation Line is Out Now!
notes.content:
On your feet, soldier! It’s time to ship out to Northridge Outpost, as Terminator: Resistance Annihilation Line is out now. Be quick, not only does the Resistance need your support but you can also get a 10% discount for one week only!

Check out the launch trailer: [url=bit.ly/term-al-launch-trailer-youtube]https://youtu.be/IbVf_Uqek0c[/url]

With [b]Annihilation Line[/b], we wanted to continue the mission statement we set out when we released the main game; creating a gaming experience which accurately reflects the original vision of the Terminator franchise as seen in [i]The Terminator[/i] and [i]T2: Judgment Day.[/i] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35880602/c856d036493a4259cdc95b2e54a7b7fdf790fbd4.png[/img]

But we also wanted to build upon this and introduce fan-favourite characters like [i]Kyle Reese[/i], as well as incorporate enemies unused in the feature films such as the [i]HK Centurion[/i], and expand the lore in a way that felt natural and respectful. We hope that you enjoy returning to the post-Judgment Day future, and we can’t wait to see your thoughts, impressions, and screenshots!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35880602/7f13a40284f7628f5d1c08eae3a6fae8fb7054d7.gif[/img]

[i]Key Features[/i]
[list]
[*] A thrilling, action-packed original story featuring over 4 hours of new content, which will delve deeper into the history of Jacob Rivers and take players to new areas of post-apocalyptic California.
[*] Fight shoulder-to-shoulder with the iconic Resistance hero Kyle Reese and help him become the man who will sacrifice everything for the sake of a better future. Plus, meet other characters exclusive to the DLC, and live out Kyle’s visions of the future seen in [i]The Terminator[/i]. 
[*] Venture beyond the line of fire as you cross Skynet’s deadly Annihilation Line, and carry out a vital mission to strike a deadly blow to the machines. Arm yourself with an expanded arsenal of weapons, and defend against enemies never before seen in a Terminator video game such as the T-600 and HK Centurion. 
[*] Enjoy the fullest frame rate and resolution possible with AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35880602/90d1e8bbf53ade065e32dd85b46394094e4e6d84.gif[/img]
While this is our last piece of DLC content for Terminator: Resistance, please continue to follow our social channels for further information on our upcoming projects.

Hasta la Vista, baby!

Reef Entertainment & Teyon

notes.title: Free Content Update - Infiltrator Mode
notes.content:
[h2]INCOMING MISSION PARAMETERS FROM SKYNET: ELIMINATE TECH-COM FIELD COMMANDER RAMIREZ[/h2]

Experience the other side of the Future War in the Terminator: Resistance Infiltrator Mode. Get under the skin of a T-800 series Infiltrator unit and proceed across a brand-new map as you gather intelligence on the Resistance, destroy key outposts…and eliminate anything standing in your way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35880602/6583abdb5ffffef5f1a2bee423704860171be5da.jpg[/img]

[b]BECOME A TERMINATOR[/b] – Take on the role of an iconic T-800 series Infiltrator and utilize a wide variety of weaponry as you breach the defenses of the Resistance forces.

[b]KNOWLEDGE IS POWER[/b] – Build up your data banks with INTEL claimed from Resistance patrols and caches to discover the locations of key enemy strongholds. 

[b]PURSUE AND DESTROY[/b] – Root out and eliminate the TECH-COM FIELD COMMANDER, but prepare carefully; should you fail in your mission, you’ll have to start again from the beginning. 

[b]COMPARE YOUR TECHNIQUE[/b] - Once you’ve completed your mission, post your score on the Steam Leaderboards to contrast your methods against others across the globe. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35880602/66121b6c1b6350a9137e1552829567271ea2f11e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Zero Day Exploit Comics[/h2]
Discover what befell Commander Baron and Doctor Mack before the events of the main game. Get the Official prequel comics, Terminator: Resistance - Zero Day Exploit Parts 1 & 2, as a free digital download with the update.

The comic is downloaded in PDF format, after updating your game it can be found with the game's local files.

[b]Instructions:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Right click Terminator: Resistance in your Steam library
[*] Select "Properties"
[*] Select the "Local Files" tab at the top of the window
[*] Click the "Browse Local Files" button
[*] Open the Zero Day Exploit comic file with your preferred PDF program
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35880602/41e60965507ceda88ceb28dfe8f2a9bc82dee230.png[/img]

notes.title: Game Update - Balance, Immersion and Localisation
notes.content:
Teyon have released a major title update for Terminator: Resistance on Steam. It includes some highly requested balance, technical and gameplay updates. We have also added support for some additional languages.

This is a great time to give the game a second playthrough, you can also reach out to us at [url=https://twitter.com/Reef_Games]@Reef_Games[/url] on Twitter if you want to provide feedback!

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]
[h2]Additional Languages[/h2] [list]
[*]Russian subtitles and text are now supported
[*]Japanese subtitles and text are now supported
[*]Simplified Chinese subtitles and text are now supported
[/list]
[h2]Balance[/h2][list]
[*]General enemy AI Improvements and fixes
[*]Enemies will behave differently based on difficulty selection
[*]Improved general balance of difficulty levels. 
[*]Loot found will now differ depending on the difficulty
[*]Weapon stats will differ between difficulties
[*]General weapon stats have been slightly modified
[*]Skill tree variables have been slightly modified
[*]Rail plasma weapons (Snipers) now consume 5 ammo rounds per shot, instead of 1
[*]TC16 plasma weapons (Semi-Auto rifles) now consume 2 ammo rounds per shot, instead of 1
[/list]
[h2]Video/Graphics[/h2][list]
[*]FOV (Field of view) slider added to video options
[*]FidelityFX (AMD) option added to video options (Contrast-Adaptive Sharpening and upscaling)
[*]Immersion Upgrades - HUD modification options added. You can now enable/disable individual HUD elements to make the game more immersive
[*]Improved support for Ultrawide resolutions
[*]Level lighting & post-processing improvements
[*]Chromatic aberration toggle added to video options
[*]Other small graphics improvements and tweaks
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay[/h2][list]
[*]Player movement/locomotion has been slightly improved
[/list]
[h2]Other[/h2][list]
[*]Save backup system added to help prevent data being lost
[*]Numerous crash fixes
[*]Other small bug fixes and improvements
[/list]
